conviction_note: Q3 numbers are new (nothing pre-released) and the H1 run-rate (+9.1% revenue on the new perimeter) sits well above a ~5% FY guide against an easy Q3 2025 comp, so there is a modest upside lean on a firmed or raised guide; that lean is offset by the run into the print (+5% in 5 days, near the EUR 17.64 52-week high) and a flat aesthetic peer read (InMode Q3 flat). Hence p_up 55 on an abs_move of 5%. Most likely the release lands after the 13 Nov close, which would put the move outside the sealed bmo window.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 2026 revenue and EBIT on the new perimeter: likely growth above the guide pace, given H1 at +9.1% and a soft Q3 2025 comp (+1.4% group revenue, medical hurt by the interrupted Cynosure supply); seasonally the smallest quarter. Mildly up.
FY2026 guide (revenue growth ~5% / >5%, EBIT margin up): reiterate most likely, with some chance of an upgrade or firming given the run-rate. Up if it changes.
Net financial position at 30 Sept (184.5m at June): unknown. Cash generation has beaten expectations before (Q3 2025, Q1 2026 notes).
Any update on the Cutlite capital loss (~EUR 4m, Q4) and on the post-disposal perimeter: already public, roughly neutral.

findings.finding: H1 2026 revenue on the new medical-heavy perimeter grew +9.1% (EBIT +37.6%) against a FY guide of growth 'around 5%' with a better EBIT margin. The Q3 2025 comp is soft (group revenue +1.4%; medical held back by the interrupted Cynosure supply). So Q3 is likely to run above the guide pace and gives management room to firm or raise the FY guide that it only 'confirmed' at H1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Day-after reactions to El.En. releases with a confirmed guide: H1 2026 +7.25% (11 Sept 2026, EBIT well above), Q3 2025 +2.82% (17 Nov 2025, cash above expectations), Q1 2026 -1.74% (18 May 2026, despite an EBIT beat). Beats have mostly been bought, but not always.
findings.original_quote: i risultati delineano la concreta possibilita di raggiungere pienamente la guidance annuale ... potranno essere raggiunti anche con il nuovo perimetro del gruppo (the results show a concrete possibility of fully reaching the annual guidance ... which can be reached with the group's new perimeter too)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is +11% over 60 days and +5% over 5 days, near its high. A guide raise has not been pre-released (no comunicato price sensitive since the 5 Nov closing), and with four analysts and EUR 0.6m a day of turnover an upgrade would not be positioned for. Had a raise been fully priced, the stock would sit above the EUR 19-19.5 targets rather than at 16.9.

findings.finding: InMode, a listed aesthetic-device peer, reported Q3 2026 revenue of $92.1m on 11 Nov, flat year on year, with consumables -3% and capital equipment 'relatively stable'. That is a flat end-market read for aesthetics, a large part of El.En.'s medical business.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed history of El.En. trading on peer prints; El.En. has outgrown the aesthetic peers through 2026 (medical +9.2% like-for-like in Q1).
findings.why_not_priced: Weak proxy: InMode pre-announced the quarter in October and is US/Israel-centred with a different product mix. El.En. rose +2.2% on 11-12 Nov, so the market did not read it across. Its weight is small for that reason.

findings.finding: The Cutlite Penta closing on 5 Nov brings an expected consolidated capital loss of about EUR 4m. That is a Q4 one-off below the line, offset by ~EUR 13m of cash and ~EUR 24m of net debt leaving the group; the Q3 release will likely restate it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Closing release published 5 Nov 19:14 (after close); stock -0.56% on 6 Nov.
findings.original_quote: si puo ragionevolmente prevedere una minusvalenza complessiva dell'ordine di grandezza di 4 milioni di euro (an overall capital loss of the order of EUR 4 million can reasonably be expected)
findings.why_not_priced: Already public and largely priced (a muted -0.56% reaction). It is filed because it will reappear in the release as a Q4 item with no path to the operating guide.

language_note: The Italian Teleborsa copy carried the exact guide wording ('crescita del fatturato attorno al 5%', 'raggiungere pienamente la guidance ... anche con il nuovo perimetro') that defines the bar; no English source carried it.
The Italian closing comunicato carried the expected ~EUR 4m minusvalenza and the ~24m of deconsolidated net debt; the English coverage (optics.org) gave only the EUR 21m headline.
The Q3 2025 Italian release carried the Cynosure supply interruption behind the soft comp.

lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' and 'too small about the move': the run-rate finding was refiled as a guidance finding and raised from +0.8 to +1.0; abs_move_pct went from 4.0 to 5.0 because the Q3 numbers are new and nothing was pre-released (the base rate for new numbers is ~7%, held below that because the name's own release-day moves run 2-7% and Q3 is the smallest interim).
Session lesson: session_check opens with 'amc' and gives the issuer's prior release timestamps, because the sealed bmo window likely misses the release.
'A one-off is sold' and 'already public is worth 0': the Cutlite capital loss was cut from -0.2 to -0.1.
The truncated-zero register lesson is reflected in positioning_check (no positioning anchor).
